name: Catherine A. Murphy
bioAdditions: She died as Catherine Jones (her second husband's name): the 1931 index lists CATHERINE JONES, Plymouth, county 40, 4 Apr 1931, file 43660 (S1). In 1870 she was "Catherine," 9, in Martin and Alice Murphy's household in Plymouth Township (S2). Her daughter Agnes's 1914 marriage docket gives Catharine's birthplace as Schuylkill County (S3).

conflicts.foundValue: Schuylkill Co., Pa. (daughter Agnes's 1914 marriage docket); "Penna." (daughter Elizabeth's 1923 licence)
conflicts.assessment: The Murphys had a child born in Schuylkill Co. in 1857 and were in Plymouth by 1860 (round 3). A Schuylkill birth for Catherine is possible if the move came in 1860-61. Her 1931 death certificate (#43660) should state her birthplace and parents.

sources.citation: Pennsylvania Department of Health death certificate index, 1931 (PA State Archives RG-11), PDF p.28: "CATHERINE JONES  PLYMOUTH  J 520  40  4 4 31  43660"

sources.supports: Martin Murphy 50, miner, real estate $1100, personal $200, b. Ireland; Alice 35, keeping house, b. Ireland; Mary 13, Patrick 12, Catherine 9, James 7, John 4, and twins Martin and Thomas aged 1/12, all b. Pennsylvania.
